title: Auditing SUID and sudo rules before assuming privilege escalation
prerequisites: command execution as an unprivileged user on the target host
permission to read the rule files
excerpt: Escalation starts with an inventory: which binaries carry the SUID bit, which sudo rules exist, which capabilities are granted, and which scheduled jobs run as another user. Each entry is a hypothesis about a delegation point; the effect is only established when the delegated process is observed running as the other principal.
